encodingDesc.p: Printed small capitals transcribed in uppercase; ordinary line-wrap hyphenation joined explicitly; lexical hyphens, spelling, punctuation, brackets and printed footnote pointers retained. Raw digital HTML/XML, scan crops and source bytes remain recoverable. Comparisons may fold case and ae/æ; display text does not.

div.head: Whiston’s chapter headings (compiled index)
div.note: These headings are transcribed from the 1856 Auburn and Rochester printing of William Whiston’s translation. Their arrangement as an index is editorial; this is not a reproduction of an original printed table of contents.
div.head: BOOK IV.
div.p: CONTAINING THE INTERVAL OF THIRTY-EIGHT YEARS.
FROM THE REJECTION OF THAT GENERATION, TO THE DEATH OF MOSES.

list.label: I
list.item: THE FIGHT OF THE HEBREWS WITH THE CANAANITES, WITHOUT THE CONSENT OF MOSES; AND THEIR DEFEAT.
list.label: II
list.item: THE SEDITION OF CORAH AND OF THE MULTITUDE AGAINST MOSES, AND AGAINST HIS BROTHER, CONCERNING THE PRIESTHOOD.
list.label: III
list.item: HOW THOSE THAT STIRRED UP THIS SEDITION WERE DESTROYED, ACCORDING TO THE WILL OF GOD; AND HOW AARON, MOSES'S BROTHER, BOTH HE AND HIS POSTERITY, RETAINED THE PRIESTHOOD.
list.label: IV
list.item: WHAT HAPPENED TO THE HEBREWS DURING THIRTY-EIGHT YEARS IN THE WILDERNESS.
list.label: V
list.item: HOW MOSES CONQUERED SIHON AND OG, KINGS OF THE AMORITES, AND DESTROYED THEIR WHOLE ARMY, AND THEN DIVIDED THEIR LAND BY LOT TO TWO TRIBES AND A HALF OF THE HEBREWS.
list.label: VI
list.item: CONCERNING BALAAM THE PROPHET, AND WHAT KIND OF MAN HE WAS.
list.label: VII
list.item: HOW THE HEBREWS FOUGHT WITH THE MIDIANITES, AND OVERCAME THEM.
list.label: VIII
list.item: THE POLITY SETTLED BY MOSES; AND HOW HE DISAPPEARED FROM AMONG MANKIND.
